candidates.title: Panic kill-switch fabricated closing trades and hardcoded disarm PINs
candidates.attacker: Any local API caller; the hardcoded PIN was guessable by anyone
candidates.principal_impacted: Forensic evidence integrity (fabricated closes) and lockdown control
source_trace: trigger_emergency_kill_switch wrote synthetic close records for open positions without broker authority
disarm compared against hardcoded PIN hashes present in source
candidates.failed_control: No broker confirmation before writing closes; secrets embedded in code
candidates.proven_result: Trigger now only locks down and records flattened_positions_count=0 with flattening=DISABLED_NO_ORDER_AUTHORITY; disarm requires KUANTRA_PANIC_DISARM_SECRET (compare_digest) or raises PANIC_DISARM_UNCONFIGURED
candidates.remediation: Remove fabrication; external secret for disarm; explicit no-order-authority marker

candidates.title: Live-execution guard missing on cancel/open-orders and model routes
candidates.attacker: Local API caller operating outside PAPER mode
source_trace: dispatch_order enforced paper mode; cancel and open-order routes did not call the guard
model start also accepted mock_mode and custom url
candidates.failed_control: Guard implemented on a single route
candidates.proven_result: _require_paper_execution_mode now gates dispatch, cancel, and open-order routes (LIVE -> 403 LIVE_EXECUTION_DISABLED, other -> 403 UNSUPPORTED_EXECUTION_MODE); model start rejects custom url and ignores mock_mode
candidates.remediation: Central execution-mode guard reused by all execution routes

candidates.title: Broker import discrepancy amplification copied wholesale into responses
source_trace: reconciliation produced O(rows) discrepancies (probe: 450 for 150 rows)
review summary copied the entire list into the response
candidates.failed_control: No output bound on review discrepancies
candidates.proven_result: Review copies at most 100 discrepancies and reports discrepancy_count and discrepancies_truncated; probe confirms 450 counted / 100 returned
candidates.conditions: Any import scale above the cap
candidates.remediation: Slice response list; keep full count

candidates.title: Copy broadcast created unverifiable signals when no secret configured
source_trace: create_master_signal signed with the node private key when no shared secret existed
no peer can verify that signature, so the signal is unusable and misleading
candidates.failed_control: Endpoint produced signals that verification always rejects
candidates.proven_result: Endpoint returns 503 COPY_SIGNAL_SECRET_UNCONFIGURED unless KUANTRA_COPY_SIGNAL_SECRET is set; with the secret the signal verifies
candidates.remediation: Fail closed on broadcast without configured secret
